name: Pharmacy & Medicine Counter
description: Фразы для аптеки: покупка лекарств без рецепта, дозировки, симптомы, консультация фармацевта.

entries.word: I am looking for something for a headache.
Do you have anything stronger for migraines?
Is this available without a prescription?
I have a prescription from my doctor here.
Could you check if this prescription is ready?
What do you recommend for a dry cough?
Something for an upset stomach please.
I need allergy tablets for hay fever season.
entries.translation: Мне нужны таблетки от аллергии на сезон пыльцы.

entries.word: Are these antihistamines drowsy or non drowsy?
entries.translation: Эти антигистаминные вызывают сонливость или нет?

entries.word: How often should I take these tablets?
One tablet twice daily after meals.
entries.translation: По одной таблетке дважды в день после еды.

entries.word: Should I take it with food or on empty stomach?
Take with plenty of water.
Can I take this with my other medications?
entries.translation: Можно совмещать это с другими моими лекарствами?

entries.word: Any known side effects I should expect?
Drowsiness is the most common side effect.
Stop taking it if you develop a rash.
I am allergic to penicillin.
Is this product suitable for children?
What dosage for a seven year old?
Children doses depend on weight, not age.
entries.translation: Детские дозы зависят от веса, а не возраста.

entries.word: Is this safe during pregnancy?
Consult your doctor before combining with pregnancy.
Do you carry baby fever reducers?
A thermometer would help too please.
Digital thermometers beat mercury ones nowadays.
I need bandages and antiseptic for a cut.
entries.translation: Нужны бинты и антисептик для пореза.

entries.word: Hydrogen peroxide stings but cleans well.
Do you sell elastic knee supports?
I twisted my ankle, what do you suggest?
RICE means rest ice compression elevation.
entries.translation: RICE значит покой, лёд, компрессия, возвышение.

entries.word: Something for muscle soreness after workouts.
entries.translation: Что-нибудь от мышечной боли после тренировок.

entries.word: This anti-inflammatory gel rubs in easily.
Do not apply gel on broken skin.
entries.translation: Не наносите гель на повреждённую кожу.

entries.word: I need sunburn relief lotion urgently.
entries.translation: Срочно нужно средство от солнечных ожогов.

entries.word: Aloe vera gel cools burns instantly.
What SPF would you recommend for fair skin?
entries.translation: Какой SPF посоветуете для светлой кожи?

entries.word: SPF fifty plus reapply every two hours.
entries.translation: SPF пятьдесят плюс, обновляйте каждые два часа.

entries.word: Do you have motion sickness tablets?
Take one hour before the journey starts.
entries.translation: Примите за час до начала поездки.

entries.word: Something for insect bites that itch.
entries.translation: Что-нибудь от зуда после укусов насекомых.

entries.word: Antihistamine cream reduces itching quickly.
I ran out of my blood pressure medication.
entries.translation: У меня закончились таблетки от давления.

entries.word: Refills require the original prescription box.
Can you order this medication for tomorrow?
entries.translation: Можно заказать это лекарство к завтрашнему дню?

entries.word: We can order it, arrives Thursday morning.
entries.translation: Мы можем заказать, придёт в четверг утром.

entries.word: Is there a generic version of this brand?
Generics contain the same active ingredient cheaper.
entries.translation: Дженерики содержат то же действующее вещество дешевле.

entries.word: How much does this cost without insurance?
Do you accept this insurance card?
Your insurance covers part of the total.
Keep the receipt for reimbursement claims.
Vitamins sit on aisle three.
I need vitamin D drops for winter months.
entries.translation: Нужен витамин D в каплях на зимние месяцы.

entries.word: Prenatal vitamins come highly recommended here.
Do you have probiotics after antibiotics?
Take probiotics two hours apart from antibiotics.
entries.translation: Пробиотики принимайте с разницей в два часа от антибиотиков.

entries.word: Finish the entire antibiotic course regardless.
entries.translation: Антибиотики пропейте курсом до конца в любом случае.

entries.word: Stopping early breeds resistant bacteria.
I need a first aid kit for travel.
Travel kits should include rehydration salts.
entries.translation: В дорожную аптечку входят соли для регидратации.

entries.word: Do you stock mosquito repellent with DEET?
entries.translation: Есть репеллент от комаров с ДЭТА?

entries.word: Thirty percent DEET suffices for most regions.
entries.translation: Тридцати процентов ДЭТА хватает для большинства регионов.

entries.word: My contact lens solution ran out.
entries.translation: У меня закончился раствор для линз.

entries.word: Saline differs from multipurpose cleaning solution.
Do you deliver prescriptions to hotels?
Home delivery costs nothing above twenty euros.
The pharmacy closes at eight tonight.
Which pharmacy stays open all night?
The duty pharmacy rota is posted outside.
Consultations behind that screen are free.
Can I speak to the pharmacist privately?
Describe your symptoms honestly for good advice.
entries.translation: Честно опишите симптомы для хорошего совета.

entries.word: How long have you had these symptoms?
entries.translation: Как давно у вас эти симптомы?

entries.word: More than a week warrants a doctor visit.
entries.translation: Больше недели — повод сходить к врачу.

entries.word: Pharmacists refer serious symptoms to clinics.
entries.translation: Фармацевты направляют серьёзные симптомы в клиники.

entries.word: Chest pain goes to emergency, not pharmacy.
entries.translation: Боль в груди — повод для скорой, не аптеки.

entries.word: Store this syrup in the fridge after opening.
entries.translation: Храните сироп в холодильнике после вскрытия.

entries.word: Discard medications past their expiry date.
Expired medicine loses potency unpredictably.
Pharmacies accept expired drugs for disposal.
entries.translation: Аптеки принимают просроченные лекарства на утилизацию.

entries.word: Never flush old medicine down the toilet.
entries.translation: Никогда не смывайте старые лекарства в унитаз.

entries.word: Childproof caps confuse grandparents more than kids.
entries.translation: Защитные крышки путают бабушек больше, чем детей.

entries.word: Read the patient leaflet inside the box.
Interactions warnings matter more than fine print suggests.
entries.translation: Предупреждения о взаимодействиях важнее, чем кажется.

entries.word: Grapefruit juice interacts with many pills.
entries.translation: Грейпфрутовый сок взаимодействует со многими таблетками.

entries.word: Alcohol warning labels exist for reasons.
entries.translation: Предупреждения об алкоголе написаны не просто так.

entries.word: Measure liquid doses with the provided cup.
Kitchen spoons measure nothing accurately.
entries.translation: Кухонные ложки ничего не меряют точно.

entries.word: Shake suspensions before every use.
Creams apply thin layers more effectively.
Eye drops go in the lower eyelid pocket.
entries.translation: Капли капают в кармашек нижнего века.

entries.word: Inhalers need slow deep breaths to work.
Rinse your mouth after steroid inhalers.
Nasal sprays aim slightly outward, not straight.
entries.translation: Назальные спреи направляйте чуть наружу, не прямо.

entries.word: Suppositories work best after refrigeration.
Patches stick best on clean dry skin.
entries.translation: Пластыри держатся на чистой сухой коже.

entries.word: Rotate patch sites to avoid irritation.
entries.translation: Меняйте места пластырей, чтобы избежать раздражения.

entries.word: Ask the pharmacist before dosing children.
Double doses never make up missed ones.
Missed dose? Take it unless nearly time for next.
entries.translation: Пропустили? Принимайте, если скоро следующая — нет.

entries.word: A good pharmacist answers questions doctors skip.
entries.translation: Хороший фармацевт отвечает на вопросы, которые врачи пропускают.
